title: Stagebench Nord Stage 4 evaluation rubric
changes: Rubric 3.0.0: sound is scored from measurements the harness takes at seal (fixed test notes played over Web MIDI into the sealed build, rendered and measured), not from a grader saying what it heard; and every sound criterion is reachable from the shared sample pack plus synthesis (a one-dynamic tine piano, a synthesized tonewheel or combo organ, a two-registration pipe organ). Runs created under rubric 2.0.0 are scored by 2.0.0.

evaluator.label: Claude Opus 5
evaluator.snapshotNote: Anthropic publishes no dated snapshot of Claude Opus 5: its full model id is claude-opus-5 itself (the provider's model list, read 2026-11-17). So the pin is that exact id. For a boxed evaluation the gateway records, for every request, the model id the provider says served it and the provider's request id; registration writes them to the ledger and flags drift if a request for the pinned model was served as any other id.
evaluator.policy: Every assessment is produced by a fresh agent running this model, working only inside its isolated evaluator workspace. An assessment's evaluatorModel must equal this value; bench score refuses to register anything else unless run with --allow-evaluator-model. The model id the provider actually returned is recorded with each evaluation and checked against pinnedId.

anchors.0: Missing, broken, disconnected, or contradicted by direct evidence.
anchors.1: Present but generic: not recognizably the assigned instrument, or presentation-only where behavior is required.
anchors.2: Correct structure, but measurements fall outside the specified tolerance, required landmarks are absent, or the behavior is materially incomplete.
anchors.3: Every specified measurement inside tolerance and every required element present, with detail simplified in ways a knowledgeable player would notice.
anchors.4: Matches the reference: measurements inside tolerance, nothing missing and nothing forbidden present, and detail a knowledgeable player would not distinguish from the hardware.

ratingScale.note: Rate against the measurement where one is specified, not against impression. Criteria marked scoring:"computed" are not rated at all — report their measurements and the score is derived, so no judgment enters where the spec already gives ground truth. Criteria marked scoring:"harness" are not rated or measured by the evaluator at all: the harness measured them at seal and the score is derived from its record.
ratingScale.soundReachability: For sound, "the hardware" in anchors 3 and 4 means the best that can be made from the shared sample pack and synthesis, not the Nord's own sample library, which no candidate has. The pack has an eight-layer Salamander grand, a two-dynamic Kawai upright, a Wurlitzer EP200 (four dynamics), a Pianet T (two), a CP80 (four), a Rhodes Mark I recorded at one dynamic on fifteen roots, and a pipe organ in two registrations (Loud and Quiet). It has no tonewheel, combo-organ, or synthesizer recordings. A rating never requires a recording the pack does not contain: a one-dynamic Rhodes is not marked down for missing velocity layers (credit velocity built from gain and filtering), and a synthesized B3, Vox, or Farfisa can reach 4.
ratingScale.listening: An evaluator cannot listen. A judged sound criterion's evidence is a measurement of rendered audio (an OfflineAudioContext or analyser render, an ffmpeg analysis of a recording of the build) or a reading of the source, never "sounds like". The harness audio record in artifact/evidence/ may be cited.

runAxis.note: Panel fidelity is scored once, against the final sealed artifact, because the phases are cumulative and it was previously measured three times at three different resolutions. A regression introduced in a later phase is caught here because the final artifact is the regressed one.

measurements.note: A keybed whose keys do not lay out inside it is not a keybed, however correct the key count is.
A deck allocation this far out of tolerance pushes controls off the chassis.

hardGate.note: Gates key on individual measurements rather than the criterion score: averaging five measurements dilutes one catastrophic failure into a passing number. Tripping any gate caps panel fidelity at scoreCap.

criteria.label: Chassis, silhouette & geometry
criteria.guidance: Measure against specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json at 1440x900: deck/keybed vertical allocation (0.54/0.46 +/-0.025), instrument width fraction (0.88-0.97), and the six horizontal section fractions in order. Report the measured numbers. This criterion is COMPUTED from your measurements, not rated: report the numbers and the score follows.

measurements.label: Deck vertical allocation
Keybed vertical allocation
Instrument width fraction of viewport
Instrument aspect ratio
Worst of the six section-fraction deviations

criteria.label: Hardware inventory & placement
criteria.guidance: Two separate failures, measured separately — do not charge one defect twice. requiredLandmarksPresent counts the sectionLandmarks entries that are RENDERED in their own section, whatever their z-order and whether a pointer can reach them; that is inventory and placement. controlsReachable counts the controls a pointer can actually operate. A rendered but buried control is present AND unreachable. Where sectionLandmarks and the variant reference photograph disagree, score against the photograph and report the disagreement. Reachability is measured, not inferred. For every control, hit-test a 5x5 grid of points across its bounding box with document.elementFromPoint at 1440x900 with the page unscrolled; the control counts as reachable only if at least one grid point resolves to that control or a descendant of it. Do NOT use a framework click helper: Playwright's click() programmatically scrolls an overflow:hidden container and reports success for a control the user can never reach. forbiddenPresent is counted with the detection rules in specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json under forbiddenDetection: apply each rule literally against the rendered DOM, and count a descriptor once per section that satisfies it, never by eye and never once per element. Leave forbiddenPresent null if a rule cannot be evaluated — it was the one number in this axis still resting on judgment, and counts of 0-3 across the field were not reproducible. This criterion is COMPUTED from your measurements, not rated.

measurements.label: Required section landmarks rendered in their own section
Controls a pointer can actually operate
Forbidden elements present

criteria.label: Keybed fidelity
criteria.guidance: Key count and split for the assigned variant, black/white width and height ratios, keys laid out inside the keybed bounds, pressed state. Count the keys whose box falls inside the keybed. This criterion is COMPUTED from your measurements, not rated: report the numbers and the score follows.

measurements.label: Keys whose box falls inside the keybed
Total keys
White keys
Black keys
Black-key height fraction

criteria.label: Chassis & plate colour fidelity
criteria.guidance: Sample the rendered page and compare against specs referenceColors. Report, for each of the five reference colours, whether the nearest rendered surface is within a CIE76 deltaE of 12 — count how many of the five match.

measurements.label: Reference colours matched within deltaE 12

criteria.label: Materials, legends & displays
criteria.guidance: Knob/fader/drawbar caps, LED ladders, silkscreen legends legible at rendered size, OLED treatment, and surface materials. Judged — these are not reducible to a measurement.

criteria.label: Panel state & displays
criteria.guidance: Does the panel show what the instrument is doing: control positions track their parameters, LEDs follow the active layer/section, displays read live values. Drive controls and observe.

criteria.label: Narrow-viewport retention
criteria.guidance: At 390x844 the instrument stays recognizable and usable rather than collapsing or clipping.

criteria.label: Piano voice (measured)
criteria.guidance: Measured by the harness, not rated: the instrument as it loads, played over Web MIDI. Notes across the keybed sound; the mid-range is in tune (full credit within 10 cents, which is about the smallest mistuning a listener hears on a complex tone and inside a real piano's mid-range stretch; nothing at 50, a quarter tone; the classic 44.1/48 kHz resampling bug is 147); velocity raises the level at every step and spans at least 15 dB; releases end cleanly; nothing clicks. The fixed test plan (stagebench-audio-1) is in docs/PROTOCOL-3.md and the record is artifact/evidence/stage<N>-audio.json.

measurements.label: Single test notes that sounded
Mean tuning error of the five mid-range test notes (cents, each capped at 100)
Velocity steps (16→127, eight velocities) that raise the level by at least 0.5 dB
Level range from velocity 16 to 127 (dB)
Released notes that fall 30 dB within the tail with no click at note-off
Clicks (discontinuities) while notes hold, release, and ring out

criteria.label: Declared source honesty
criteria.guidance: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares what actually produces sound. Verify by exercising the build and reading the source, not by reading the declaration; the seal's sample check (inputs/verification.json, sampleProvenance) says which bundled files are cut from which pack recording.

criteria.label: Input coverage
criteria.guidance: Pointer, computer keyboard and Web MIDI all reach one note lifecycle. Exercise each. The harness has already confirmed whether the build listens for Web MIDI on load and sounds from it (audio record: environment.midi, notesSounding); exercise pointer and keyboard yourself.

criteria.label: Voice lifecycle
criteria.guidance: Deterministic voice stealing, and all-notes-off on blur, MIDI disconnect, and unmount. Velocity and sustain are measured by the harness (sound.pianoVoice, playability.sustainPedal); do not rate them again here.

criteria.label: Sustain pedal (measured)
criteria.guidance: Measured by the harness, not rated: with CC64 down, a note released after half a second is still sounding half a second later (no more than 20 dB down; a damped note falls 30 dB or more); after CC64 up it falls at least 20 dB within a second. The fixed test plan (stagebench-audio-1) is in docs/PROTOCOL-3.md and the record is artifact/evidence/stage<N>-audio.json.

measurements.label: Sustain holds a released note, and lets it go on pedal-up

criteria.label: Control feel & decorative boundary
criteria.guidance: Controls move and report state; controls that do nothing are visibly inert. Never fake success.

criteria.label: Required Phase 1 controls present
criteria.guidance: Every control the Phase 1 contract requires exists on the panel and is identifiable.

criteria.label: Required piano feature IDs
criteria.guidance: The Phase 1 piano feature IDs are implemented and exercised in the running build.

criteria.label: Declared gaps are accurate
criteria.guidance: Anything declared unimplemented really is, and nothing undeclared is missing. Check IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json against behaviour.

criteria.label: Instrument breadth & character
criteria.guidance: Grand, Upright, Electric, Clav, Digital and Misc are distinct instruments, not one voice relabelled; measure it (spectra and envelopes of the same note on each type). Judge each against what the pack can supply: Grand from up to eight Salamander layers; Upright from the Kawai's soft and loud layers; Electric from a tine model built on the one-dynamic, fifteen-root Rhodes, or a reed or electric-grand model from the Wurlitzer, Pianet T, or CP80. A tine piano made from the Rhodes is not marked down for having no velocity layers the pack never had: credit velocity response made with gain and filtering. Clav, Digital and Misc may be honest synthesis.

criteria.label: Effect audibility & correctness
criteria.guidance: Each effect is individually audible and behaves like its namesake. Show it with a measurement: the rendered signal with the effect on against bypassed (modulation sidebands, delay taps at the set time, reverb decay, compression of peaks), not a description of what it sounds like.

criteria.label: Signal graph & routing
criteria.guidance: Per-layer buses, effects in the documented order, master gain and limiter before one destination. Read the source and probe the graph. Clipping and extra audio contexts are measured by the harness (sound.measuredVoice); do not rate them again here.

criteria.label: Default voice & output (measured)
criteria.guidance: Measured by the harness, not rated: the instrument as it loads (in this phase, the piano section) through the same test notes as Phase 1, plus the output stage: no clipping under a ten-note fortissimo chord, and only one audio context making sound. The fixed test plan (stagebench-audio-1) is in docs/PROTOCOL-3.md and the record is artifact/evidence/stage<N>-audio.json.

measurements.label: Single test notes that sounded
Mean tuning error of the five mid-range test notes (cents, each capped at 100)
Velocity steps (16→127, eight velocities) that raise the level by at least 0.5 dB
Level range from velocity 16 to 127 (dB)
Released notes that fall 30 dB within the tail with no click at note-off
Clicks (discontinuities) while notes hold, release, and ring out
Clipped output (ms at full scale, all tests)
Audio contexts producing sound beyond the one allowed

criteria.label: Two-layer piano behaviour
criteria.guidance: Layer A/B split, level, octave and focus reach the audio graph and the panel reflects them.

criteria.label: Detailed piano controls
criteria.guidance: KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release and String Res each measurably change the rendered signal (specs/nord-stage-4.piano.json). Pedal noise is excluded by that spec and is not rated.

criteria.label: Input reliability & failure behaviour
criteria.guidance: Inputs stay reliable under stress; failures degrade visibly rather than silently.

criteria.label: Required piano instruments
criteria.guidance: Every instrument the Phase 2 contract requires is present, selectable, and actually loads: Grand, Upright and Electric from the pack (any of its sources for that type), Clav, Digital and Misc as recordings or synthesis. One model per type is the requirement; more is optional and not required for a 4.

criteria.label: Required effect units and types
criteria.guidance: Every effect unit and every listed type within it is present and reachable from the panel.

criteria.label: Declared gaps are accurate
criteria.guidance: Anything declared unimplemented really is, and nothing undeclared is missing.

criteria.label: Distinct engine character
criteria.guidance: Organ, Piano and Synth are genuinely different engines, not one engine with presets; show it in the source and in rendered spectra and envelopes. The pack has no tonewheel, combo-organ or synthesizer recordings, so B3, Vox, Farfisa and the synth are synthesized, and a well-made synthesis is creditable in full. The pack's pipe organ (Loud and Quiet registrations) may voice the Pipe models alone, with synthesis, or not at all.

criteria.label: Effects & routing integration
criteria.guidance: Every engine inherits the shared effects graph and routes correctly across layers.

criteria.label: Musical quality under load (measured)
criteria.guidance: Measured by the harness, not rated: the instrument as it loads. Note-on to sound on the audio clock (full credit within 20 ms, nothing at 120), every tone of a ten-note chord present, no clipping, no clicks, notes sounding and in tune. The fixed test plan (stagebench-audio-1) is in docs/PROTOCOL-3.md and the record is artifact/evidence/stage<N>-audio.json.

measurements.label: Median note-on to sound, on the audio clock (ms)
Tones of a ten-note chord present in the render
Clipped output (ms at full scale, all tests)
Clicks (discontinuities) while notes hold, release, and ring out
Single test notes that sounded
Mean tuning error of the five mid-range test notes (cents, each capped at 100)

criteria.label: Program & state round-trip
criteria.guidance: Canonical state saves, loads and round-trips without loss; the dirty flag is truthful.

criteria.label: Performance controls & bindings
criteria.guidance: Required hardware bindings, wheels, pedals and Live Mode behave.

criteria.label: Cross-system workflows
criteria.guidance: Split points, scenes, transpose and panic behave correctly across all three engines at once.

criteria.label: Organ system
criteria.guidance: Drawbars, models, percussion, key click, rotary, vibrato/chorus (specs/nord-stage-4.organ.json). B3, Vox and Farfisa are judged as synthesis (there is nothing in the pack to sample them from): drawbar partials, percussion, key click, scanner vibrato and chorus, rotary. The Pipe drawbars may be realized by mixing and filtering the pack's two registrations, by synthesized ranks, or both; a pack-built pipe organ is not marked down for lacking per-rank recordings the pack does not have.

criteria.label: Synth system
criteria.guidance: Oscillators, filter, envelopes, LFO, unison, arpeggiator. All synthesis: the pack has no synthesizer recordings, and a sampled oscillator mode is optional.

criteria.label: Layers, splits, scenes & morphs
criteria.guidance: Layer and split handling, scenes, and morph sources reaching their destinations.

criteria.label: Programs & Live Mode
criteria.guidance: Program storage, recall, page navigation and Live Mode.

scoringKinds.computed: Derived from reported measurements. band: full credit within tolerance of target, decaying linearly to zero at decay x tolerance. range: full credit inside [minimum,maximum], decaying by the same rule using the half-width. ratio: (value/denominator)^curve as a percentage (curve defaults to 1). penaltyCount: 100 minus penaltyEach per occurrence, floored at 0. atMost: full credit at or below target, falling linearly to zero at zero. atLeast: full credit at or above target, falling linearly to zero at zero.
scoringKinds.harness: Derived from a record the harness wrote at seal, with the same measurement kinds. The evaluator does not fill these in. A measurement the harness could not take scores zero (it is never dropped and re-normalised), and a record that failed outright (no MIDI listener, no sound) scores zero throughout.
